fact: Algérie Télécom, Niger Télécom and ESCEP-Niger signed two conventions in Niamey on 8-9 September 2026 providing for a fibre-optic link between In Guezzam and Agadez with an initial capacity of 100 Gbit/s.
title: Niger-Algérie : un lien fibre de 100 Gbit/s va raccorder Agadez à la dorsale numérique transsaharienne
